name: Aaron
description: Moses' brother who became Israel's first high priest
special_moment: God appointed Aaron and his sons to serve as priests for Israel.

name: Abner
description: Commander of King Saul's army
special_moment: Abner commanded Saul's army and later supported David before Joab killed him.

name: Amasa
description: Commander of Absalom's army
special_moment: David appointed Amasa over his army, but Joab later killed him.

name: Asaph
description: Levite singer appointed to lead worship
special_moment: David appointed Asaph to minister before the ark, and several psalm titles bear his name.

name: Asher
description: Jacob's son and ancestor of the tribe of Asher
special_moment: Jacob blessed Asher with rich food, and the tribe later received land in northern Canaan.

name: Babel
description: City where God confused human language
special_moment: At Babel, God confused the builders' language and scattered them across the earth.

name: Barak
description: Commander who fought alongside Deborah
special_moment: Barak defeated Sisera's army after Deborah summoned him to lead Israel's forces.

name: Caleb
description: Spy who trusted God's promise about Canaan
special_moment: Caleb followed God wholeheartedly and later received Hebron as his inheritance.

name: Cyrus
description: Persian king who permitted the temple's rebuilding
special_moment: Cyrus issued a decree allowing the exiles to return to Jerusalem and rebuild the temple.

name: Enoch
description: Man who walked faithfully with God
special_moment: Enoch walked with God, and then God took him away.

name: Ethan
description: Ezrahite whose wisdom Solomon surpassed
special_moment: Ethan was renowned for wisdom, though Solomon was described as wiser.

name: Hanan
description: Benjaminite named in a biblical genealogy
special_moment: Hanan is listed among the descendants of Shashak who lived in Jerusalem.

name: Haran
description: Abram's brother and Lot's father
special_moment: Haran died in Ur of the Chaldeans before his father Terah.

name: Heber
description: Kenite husband of Jael
special_moment: Sisera fled to Heber's tent, where Jael killed him while he slept.

name: Hosea
description: Prophet who warned the northern kingdom
special_moment: Hosea's marriage portrayed God's faithful love toward unfaithful Israel.

name: Joash
description: King hidden from Athaliah as a child
special_moment: Joash was hidden for six years and crowned king at the age of seven.

name: Jonah
description: Prophet sent to preach to Nineveh
special_moment: Jonah spent three days and nights inside a great fish before going to Nineveh.

name: Jorah
description: Ancestor of a family that returned from exile
special_moment: Ezra lists 112 descendants of Jorah among those who returned with Zerubbabel.

name: Joram
description: Son of Ahab who became king of Israel
special_moment: Joram reigned over Israel for twelve years and removed the sacred stone of Baal.

name: Judah
description: Jacob's son and ancestor of the tribe of Judah
special_moment: Judah became the ancestor of the royal line of David.

name: Laban
description: Rebekah's brother and Jacob's uncle
special_moment: Laban deceived Jacob into marrying Leah before Rachel.

name: Lydia
description: Purple-cloth merchant who welcomed Paul's message
special_moment: Lydia and her household were baptized, and she hosted Paul and his companions.

name: Manna
description: Food God provided for Israel in the wilderness
special_moment: Manna sustained Israel during the wilderness journey and is discussed by Jesus in John 6.

name: Micah
description: Prophet from Moresheth who warned Judah
special_moment: Micah called God's people to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with God.

name: Moses
description: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt
special_moment: God worked through Moses to lead Israel through the sea and toward the promised land.

name: Nahum
description: Prophet who announced Nineveh's downfall
special_moment: Nahum delivered an oracle concerning God's judgment on Nineveh.

name: Pekah
description: King of Israel who overthrew Pekahiah
special_moment: Pekah seized the throne but later lost Israelite territory to Assyria.

name: Rahab
description: Jericho woman who hid Israelite spies
special_moment: Rahab protected the spies, and her household was spared when Jericho fell.

name: Reuel
description: Father of Zipporah in the story of Moses
special_moment: Moses stayed with Reuel's family and married his daughter Zipporah.

name: Sarah
description: Abraham's wife and Isaac's mother
special_moment: Sarah gave birth to Isaac in her old age, fulfilling God's promise.

name: Satan
description: Adversary who accused Job
special_moment: Satan challenged Job's faithfulness before God.

name: Silas
description: Paul's companion on his second missionary journey
special_moment: Silas was imprisoned with Paul in Philippi and prayed with him at midnight.

name: Tamar
description: Judah's daughter-in-law and mother of Perez
special_moment: Tamar became the mother of Perez and Zerah through Judah.

name: Titus
description: Paul's coworker entrusted with churches in Crete
special_moment: Paul left Titus in Crete to appoint elders and complete unfinished work.

name: Uzzah
description: Man struck dead after taking hold of the ark
special_moment: Uzzah reached for the ark when the oxen stumbled and died beside it.

name: David
description: Second king of Israel, anointed by Samuel
special_moment: David captured Jerusalem and later ruled over all Israel.

name: Herod
description: King who sought to kill the child Jesus
special_moment: Herod ordered the killing of boys in Bethlehem in an attempt to eliminate the Messiah.

name: Judas
description: Disciple who betrayed Jesus
special_moment: Judas betrayed Jesus for thirty pieces of silver and later hanged himself.

name: Ariel
description: Poetic name for Jerusalem in Isaiah's oracle
special_moment: Isaiah announced that Ariel, the city where David settled, would face distress.

name: Zobah
description: Aramean kingdom defeated by David
special_moment: David defeated the king of Zobah while restoring his control near the Euphrates.

name: Sodom
description: City destroyed in Abraham and Lot's time
special_moment: The Lord destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah with burning sulfur.

name: Sceva
description: Father of seven Jewish exorcists in Ephesus
special_moment: Sceva's sons tried to invoke Jesus' name and were overpowered by an evil spirit.

name: Selah
description: Untranslated musical or liturgical term in Psalms
special_moment: Selah occurs repeatedly in Psalms and Habakkuk, though its precise meaning is uncertain.

name: Sinai
description: Mountain where God gave Israel the covenant law
special_moment: God descended on Mount Sinai in fire and smoke before speaking to Israel.

name: Cross
description: Instrument on which Jesus was crucified
special_moment: Jesus was crucified at Golgotha between two other men.

name: Anani
description: Descendant of David named in a genealogy
special_moment: Anani is listed as one of the seven sons of Elioenai.

name: Swine
description: Herd of pigs entered by expelled demons
special_moment: The herd rushed down a steep bank and drowned after the spirits entered it.

name: Widow
description: Mother at Zarephath whose son Elijah raised
special_moment: Elijah prayed, and the widow's son returned to life.

name: Booth
description: Temporary shelter used during the Feast of Booths
special_moment: Israel lived in booths during the festival to remember the exodus from Egypt.

name: Peter
description: Apostle who confessed Jesus as the Messiah
special_moment: Peter became a leading witness in the early church and preached at Pentecost.

name: James
description: Apostle who was the son of Zebedee and John's brother
special_moment: James belonged to Jesus' inner circle and witnessed the Transfiguration.

name: Jacob
description: Son of Isaac and Rebekah who was renamed Israel
special_moment: Jacob wrestled until daybreak and received the name Israel.
